values: HELP University ANPR Parking System Gantt Chart
Proposed schedule: September 2026 to April 2027. Intermediate dates are planning estimates, not confirmed deadlines.
Edit amber cells: task details, start/end dates, type and progress. Duration, date checks and weekly bars update automatically.
Progress is blank until entered. Green = planned work; purple M = milestone. Each column represents a Monday–Sunday week.
34 weeks shown; change D6 to move the timeline. Dates do not automatically reschedule dependent tasks.
Red NOW marks the current week. Change D7 to update the marker.
Write literature synthesis and research gap
Design database, access rules and admin workflows
Develop backend, database and admin login
Obtain partner model and establish baseline
Plan plate photo collection and get permission
Collect Malaysian plate photos and label them
Set aside test photos and make varied training copies
Adapt and fine-tune the provided model
Evaluate outdoor accuracy and analyse errors
Implement vehicle, permit and visitor management
Implement payment status and entry-exit records
Prepare camera and barrier test environment
Integrate recognition with parking access workflow
Run pilot and resolve integration issues
Prepare 20+ test cases and outdoor trial plan
Run functional and repeated outdoor trials
Fix defects, retest and evaluate performance
Write methods, implementation and results chapters
Prepare final report, demonstration and presentation
Complete testing and final project review
Assignment deadline: 5 October 2026. Objective milestones: design November 2026, AI February 2027, integration March 2027, testing April 2027.
Detailed dates are estimates. Stakeholder requirements were gathered early; September 14–25 is a planning allocation. Confirm final report dates.
Model training depends on partner weights/code and usable Malaysian images. Keep the evaluation set separate from training and tuning.
Backend, database and login start with mock plate results; they do not wait for the partner model. Model training still depends on model delivery and data.
Proposed: 90% complete-plate accuracy, response time below 3 seconds, and 95% operational reliability. Agree measurement definitions with the supervisor.
Use real Excel dates in Start and Finish. Set milestones to the same start/end date. Days are inclusive calendar days; milestones have zero duration.
Enter 0%–100% yourself. It is a tracking field only; green bars show the planned schedule, not actual completion.
Insert and copy a complete task row within the schedule to preserve formulas and formatting, then change its ID, details and dates.
Project proposal and objectives supplied in this conversation. All detailed task dates are suggested planning allocations.
